Our Craft

Six services. One standard.

Why Ecowoods

Built to last three generations.

The Toronto flooring market is crowded with subcontractors, brokers, and one-truck operations. We are none of those. Ecowoods is a single shop, owned and operated by the same family since 1998.

01

Master Craftsmen, Not Subcontractors

Every installer is a salaried Ecowoods employee — many with us 10+ years. No revolving day-labour crews, no language gaps, no surprises.

02

Lifetime Workmanship Warranty

We stand behind our work for as long as you own the home. If we did the floor, we own the floor. Period.

03

Eco-Friendly From the Sawmill Up

FSC-certified species, water-based finishes (≤50 g/L VOC), zero-formaldehyde adhesives, and HEPA dust extraction on every job.

04

Fixed Pricing, In Writing

Your in-home estimate is the price you pay. No mid-job surprises, no hidden charges for "unforeseen conditions" — we already saw them.

Our Process

From sample to signed-off.

Five steps. One project manager from start to finish. No salespeople, no handoffs, no surprises.

01

Free In-Home Consultation

A senior estimator walks the space, takes measurements, listens to how you live, and brings species and finish samples to your kitchen table.

45–60 min
02

Fixed-Price Written Estimate

Within 24 hours you receive a line-itemed PDF estimate. No square-foot ranges, no "approximate" pricing — one final number, in writing.

Within 24h
03

Sample Approval & Scheduling

Stain samples brushed on your actual subfloor. Once you approve, we lock the date and order materials. Most jobs start within 2–3 weeks.

2–3 weeks
04

Installation & Finishing

Acclimation, install, sanding, staining, sealing — all by the same crew, all done in sequence. Typical 1,200 sq ft job: 5 to 7 working days.

5–7 days
05

Walkthrough & Warranty

We walk every square foot with you. Anything not perfect is fixed before we leave. You sign off. Lifetime workmanship warranty activates.

Questions

Things we hear at the kitchen table.

The questions every Toronto homeowner asks us during the in-home consultation — answered honestly here, before you call.

For a standard 1,000–1,500 sq ft single-floor installation, plan on 5 to 7 working days from the day we arrive: one day for moisture testing and acclimation, two to three days for installation, and two to three days for sanding, staining, and finishing. Site-finished floors need an extra day for final coat curing.
Yes. Our dust containment captures roughly 99.7% of airborne particulate at the source using HEPA-sealed Festool and Bona Atomic systems. Most of our refinishing clients sleep in their homes every night of the job. Water-based finishes have low odour and are walk-on ready in 2–4 hours.
Solid is one piece of wood, typically 3/4 inch thick, sandable five or six times over its lifetime. Engineered is a real-wood top layer (2–6 mm) bonded to a multi-ply core, which makes it more stable across humidity swings — important in Toronto basements, condos, and over radiant heat. Both are real hardwood; the right answer depends on your subfloor and humidity environment.
Materials run from roughly $4/sq ft (entry-level red oak) to $20+/sq ft (wide-plank European white oak or specialty species). Installation in the GTA typically adds $3–$6/sq ft for solid and $4–$8/sq ft for engineered, including subfloor prep. Refinishing existing floors generally runs $3.50–$5.50/sq ft. Every Ecowoods quote is fixed — no per-foot ranges in your contract.
Every finish we apply is water-based, low-VOC (≤50 g/L), and GreenGuard Gold certified — Bona Traffic HD, Loba 2K Supra, and Pallmann Magic Oil. We also stock FSC-certified species and use zero-formaldehyde adhesives. If anyone in your household has chemical sensitivities, tell us at the consultation; we will spec the entire stack accordingly.
No. We tape and protect every baseboard with reusable rubber edge guards before sanding. Our edgers are 4-inch random-orbit machines that finish flush to the baseboard without contact. After 25 years of refinishing in Toronto heritage homes, we have not damaged a baseboard yet.
Dust mop daily, damp mop weekly with a Bona-recommended cleaner (never water, never vinegar, never Murphy Oil Soap). Add felt pads under furniture, trim pet nails, and keep indoor humidity between 35% and 55% year-round — a whole-home humidifier in winter is the single best investment for Toronto wood floors.
Yes. Every Ecowoods installation comes with a lifetime workmanship warranty for as long as you own the home — transferable once at sale. Material warranties from the manufacturer (typically 25–35 years on finish, 50 years on structural) pass through to you on top. Everything is in writing in your contract.
